journey.title: Inspect a scope and its maintenance health
journey.purpose: An operator opens the ledger, selects a scope, reviews source versus derived state, and verifies the bounded compaction frontier.

steps.intent: See available scopes and corpus health before selecting a scope.
Inspect the scope journal, derived canopy, and maintenance outcome.
Review eligible frontier nodes and confirm the recall budget is bounded.

claims.statement: The journey labels authoritative journal content separately from rebuildable derived state.
claims.rationale: Source Ledger must make it possible to inspect derived results without confusing them with the append-only corpus authority.
